The bug was in `cart_total` in `shop.py`. It added each product's price once and ignored the quantity. I changed the line to `total += PRICES[product] * count`.

This also fixed `test_receipt`. Two breads at 250 cents with the 50% code now come to $2.50. All 4 tests pass.
